pokedexEntries.bk: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.

pokedexEntries.wh: When they encounter foes bigger than themselves, they try to throw them. They always travel in packs of five.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: When it encounters a foe bigger than itself, it wants to throw it. It changes belts as it gets stronger.

pokedexEntries.x: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.

pokedexEntries.or: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.

pokedexEntries.y: When it encounters a foe bigger than itself, it wants to throw it. It changes belts as it gets stronger.

pokedexEntries.as: When it encounters a foe bigger than itself, it wants to throw it. It changes belts as it gets stronger.

pokedexEntries.sw: It performs throwing moves with first-rate skill. Over the course of many battles, Throh’s belt grows darker as it absorbs its wearer’s sweat.

pokedexEntries.sh: They train in groups of five. Any member that can’t keep up will discard its belt and leave the group.
